title: Fog clears on a night forest, a site screen rises
summary: One continuous shot: the camera pushes through dense night fog and thorny branches until a dark website screen, lying in the grass, tilts upright and settles centre frame under a moonlit sky.
use_when: a seasonal or themed teaser where the setting sells the mood and the landing page is the payoff
a single hero page to show with no feature walk-through
silent autoplay loops on social where one slow reveal is enough

look.type_style: on-screen page only: large light serif headline, sentence case, 2 lines, about 6 % of frame height at the hold; small grotesk nav and body

sfx.event: fog thins and the branches appear
camera accelerates through the branches while the screen tilts up
screen reaches upright and the push lands

structure.shot: full-frame dense blue-grey fog, nothing else readable; darker edges
structure.camera: push-in ~1.3 %/s for 1 s, then ~13 %/s with a slight up-left drift and ~2 deg roll
structure.motion: fog layers churn slowly; push accelerates, easings.inOutSine onset (speed from motion estimate, ±0.25 s)

structure.shot: fog thins: thorny branches frame the top and sides, forest and hills behind; a dark screen lies almost flat in the grass, centre low
structure.motion: fog opacity falls from full to about half over 30 fr (±0.25 s); screen visible only as a thin dark sliver with a light top edge

structure.shot: screen tilts up from lying back to upright, showing a dark landing page with a 2-line headline and one pill button; moon and castle appear
structure.camera: push-in peaks ~22 %/s at 4–5 s, then eases to ~5 %/s by 6 s; foreground branches slide out to the frame edges; slight downward drift
structure.motion: screen tilt from ~80 deg back to ~0 deg over ~60 fr (3.00–5.00, ±0.25 s), springs.heavy (overshoot not measurable); screen width ~40 % → 42 % of frame

structure.shot: upright screen centre-left, page fully readable; fog rolls along the ground in front of its base
structure.camera: push ends, then a slow pull back ~-2.6 %/s; screen width 42 % → ~38 % of frame
structure.motion: easings.outQuint settle of the push (±0.25 s); fog drifts left to right continuously

structure.shot: same composition held: screen, moonlit sky with bats, graveyard on the right, warm-lit castle on the left
structure.camera: drift: pull back ~-1.7 → 0 %/s, holds still from ~10 s; screen ~36 % of frame width
structure.motion: only the ground fog moves; no UI animation inside the page

params.screenshot: one full landing page screenshot, 16:10, dark theme reads best in the night plate
params.backdrop: a night forest plate (sky, moon, trees) plus 2 foreground branch layers and 2 fog layers
params.headline: the page's own hero line, 2 lines ≤ 6 words, must stay legible at ~36 % frame width

notes: One shot, 0 cuts in cuts.json, so every transition_out is continuous. Push speeds from motion.json (per second, 1920-wide frame); screen widths measured on sheet cells at 0.25 s resolution. Tilt angles and spring choice are estimates (not measurable at 4 fps). Reference is silent: all SFX planned by the glue rule, not measured. Proposed term (not in vocabulary): fog-clear, a reveal where layered fog thins while the camera pushes through it.
